## Problem

## Constraints / invariants

Check the ones this feature must respect (see CONTRIBUTING.md ground rules):

- [ ] No fabricated data (missing data must stay missing)
- [ ] Safety status never overridden by the suitability score
- [ ] No catch guarantees / no "scientifically validated" claims
- [ ] Works in guest mode without an account
- [ ] All four locales (ary, ar, fr, en) with RTL correctness
